notes: Hook: "On every BS 7671 job you have wired" overclaimed (BS 7671 also covers IT supplies, e.g. medical IT); corrected to "On the BS 7671 jobs you have wired" in topic.json.

In one breath: "tied to earth, the first fault is a short circuit that trips" overclaimed (a TT fault passes only a few amps through the ground, and a star point tied through a high impedance trips nothing); corrected to "tied solidly to earth, the first fault draws enough current to trip" in topic.json.

In one breath: "joined to earth through the capacitance of its cables, so a second fault on another phase is a short through the hull" gave the wrong cause (the second fault shorts through the first, not through capacitance); corrected so capacitance sets the first fault current growing with system size, and the second fault is stated on its own (i3, i4).
In one breath: "the faulted phase drops to earth" narrowed to a solid fault, as i2 states it.
Rest of hook and In one breath agree with research.json (IT first fault should not disconnect [R4]; insulated marine systems keep essential services running [R5]) and with lesson i1.
